// the problem

Every Engineering Team
Faces the Same Walls.

M3A Team doesn't suggest solutions — it enforces them. Every pain point has a dedicated agent with authority to block, approve, or veto.

PAIN_01🔥
Code Reviews Are Inconsistent
Reviews depend on who's available. Quality varies. Security holes slip through. Every merge is a gamble.
5-Agent Story-Done Gate — parallel, every merge
PAIN_02🗂️
Documentation Is Always Outdated
Nobody has time to update docs. New devs spend weeks just understanding the system. Critical knowledge lives in Slack.
Borges auto-generates Minsait-branded HTML portals
PAIN_03🔒
Security Found Too Late
Vulnerabilities in production cost 10× more to fix. Security is an afterthought, bolted on instead of built in.
Hobbes has VETO power on every single story
PAIN_04🏗️
Architecture Decisions Without Structure
No ADRs. No formal review. Architectural drift compounds until a complete rewrite is the only option.
Vitruvius generates ADRs, C4 diagrams, migration plans
PAIN_05📋
Epics Approved Without Technical Validation
Product creates epics without engineering review. Blockers discovered during implementation — too late to change direction.
12-agent multi-perspective review before sprint-1
PAIN_06📊
Tribal Knowledge Owns the System
Decisions live in the heads of people who already left. No onboarding. Each new dev reconstructs everything from scratch.
Descartes builds a persistent, searchable knowledge base
PAIN_07🌀
Sprint Planning Is Chaotic
Sprints overloaded. Stories have no acceptance criteria. DoD isn't enforced. Velocity is unpredictable.
Deming plans sprints with stories, ACs, and DoD
PAIN_08🤖
AI Usage Is Unstructured
Teams use AI ad-hoc. No consistency. No governance. No traceability. Each developer gets different quality from the same tools.
13 Immutable Laws govern every AI interaction

// from zero to governed

One Command.
A Full AI Team.

From nothing to a governed AI workforce in under 60 seconds. No external services, no extra subscriptions.

STEP_01
Install
One bash command deploys all 12 agents into your project's .github/ folder. Everything is version-controlled and reviewable via PR.
bash <(curl -fsSL …/install.sh)
STEP_02
Activate with /m3a-init
Personalizes all 12 agents with your project's stack, team conventions, and domain context. Transforms generic agents into project-aware specialists.
/m3a-init
STEP_03
Build the Knowledge Base
Descartes deep-scans the codebase, maps dependencies, identifies technical debt, and constructs a structured knowledge base all 12 agents read before every action.
/m3a-init-knowledge
STEP_04
Create Your First Epic
Drucker leads a structured brainstorm, performs anti-duplicate check, then triggers a 12-agent review. Nothing advances without consensus.
/m3a-init-epic
STEP_05
Govern Every Story
Every story passes through the Story-Done gate before it can close. No exceptions. No shortcuts. No silent agents.
/m3a-story-done STORY-N
